title: The Investigation That Reached Nvidia’s CEO

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The chip investigation began long before Nvidia lost its CEO. In June 2025, U.S. officials visited a cloud company in Singapore.
lines.shot_hint: Server aisle with an inspector's flashlight arriving on a rack plate

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They were checking how advanced chips were being used. They interviewed its chief executive, Alice Huang.
lines.shot_hint: Server aisle with an inspector's flashlight arriving on a rack plate

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By then, Washington had already asked Nvidia for sales records.
lines.shot_hint: Track the rack from latch to inventory label

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: More than a year later, reports about the woman they interviewed put Jensen Huang, Nvidia's founder, in the middle of the story.
lines.shot_hint: Track the rack from latch to inventory label

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You could have money tied to Nvidia through a fund and never have bought a share yourself.
lines.shot_hint: A monitor wakes up and lights the equipment around it

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So what did investigators know before the headlines? Start with the machine they were trying to trace.
lines.shot_hint: A monitor wakes up and lights the equipment around it

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A chip like this might be designed by Nvidia and sold inside somebody else's machine.
lines.shot_hint: Close on a technician's hands sliding a blade into a rack

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By the time an inspector sees it, it may be one component in a server that fills a rack.
lines.shot_hint: Close on a technician's hands sliding a blade into a rack

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Think of the server as the whole machine and the chips as some of the parts doing the work.
lines.shot_hint: Tilt from the blade up to the whole rack and adjoining cabinets

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A cloud company puts those machines in a data center and sells customers time on them.
lines.shot_hint: Tilt from the blade up to the whole rack and adjoining cabinets

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The customer can be somewhere else. Picture booking time in a recording studio.
lines.shot_hint: Illustrative home laptop sending a job to remote equipment

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You can work from your own laptop while the studio's expensive equipment stays where it is.
lines.shot_hint: Illustrative home laptop sending a job to remote equipment

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That gives investigators two questions. Where did the machine go? And who could use it once it was there?
lines.shot_hint: Rack-side terminal distinguishes machine location from access

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A paper trail can help answer the first question. The second can take different evidence.
lines.shot_hint: Rack-side terminal distinguishes machine location from access

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nvidia started in computer graphics. Its processors were good at doing many calculations at once.
lines.shot_hint: A graphics card moves into an open desktop in an illustrative bench scene

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Opening that computing power to software developers helped turn a gaming component into part of the infrastructure behind AI.
lines.shot_hint: A graphics card moves into an open desktop in an illustrative bench scene

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By 2024, U.S. Commerce officials had flagged possible diversion of sensitive chips. One company they wanted to understand was Megaspeed.
lines.shot_hint: A case file opens in the investigation room

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Its business was selling access to computing power. Investigators wanted to know where that power was going.
lines.shot_hint: A case file opens in the investigation room

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore started its own inquiry in February 2025. Its police and customs officials were looking at possible false declarations in server purchases.
lines.shot_hint: Warehouse aisle at the start of Singapore's inquiry

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They say they opened the case independently.
lines.shot_hint: Warehouse aisle at the start of Singapore's inquiry

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Some of those machines had been purchased by companies under investigation. Singapore confirmed the servers passed through the country on their way to Malaysia.
lines.shot_hint: A generic shipping case moves through the handoff

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That was one leg they could put on the record.
lines.shot_hint: A generic shipping case moves through the handoff

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The next leg was the hard part. Did the servers stay in Malaysia? Were any moved again?
lines.shot_hint: A single map-style graphic confirms Singapore to Malaysia and holds on the open destination

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And if the servers stayed put, who was using them? A destination on a declaration can only tell you so much.
lines.shot_hint: A single map-style graphic confirms Singapore to Malaysia and holds on the open destination

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In May, U.S. Commerce investigators asked Nvidia for records of direct or indirect sales to Megaspeed. Think about that request.
lines.shot_hint: Top-down view of the May request sliding into a records folder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nvidia could sell through partners, and investigators wanted the records from both paths.
lines.shot_hint: Top-down view of the May request sliding into a records folder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The agencies say Nvidia put Megaspeed on its no-sell list in June. That was a decision about sales.
lines.shot_hint: An order is paused while nearby warehouse racks remain

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The machines investigators wanted to account for could already be out in the field.
lines.shot_hint: An order is paused while nearby warehouse racks remain

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On June 24, U.S. officials conducted an on-site end-use check with Alice Huang present.
lines.shot_hint: Return to a tightly framed inventory check on the June 24 rack

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore police interviewed her that day for their own investigation. The first scene of this story took place on the record.
lines.shot_hint: Return to a tightly framed inventory check on the June 24 rack

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: What the two inquiries found is a different question.
lines.shot_hint: Return to a tightly framed inventory check on the June 24 rack

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore's investigation concerned its own laws.
lines.shot_hint: Two folders on separate sides of an investigation desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The U.S. Justice Department says it took the lead in the U.S. criminal investigation of Megaspeed after the enforcement action.
lines.shot_hint: Two folders on separate sides of an investigation desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Both inquiries touched the same company.
lines.shot_hint: Two folders on separate sides of an investigation desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By February 2026, Singapore police and prosecutors found insufficient evidence to establish that Alice Huang had committed the suspected declaration offenses.
lines.shot_hint: A close detail of the Singapore finding with the agency/date visible

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore said it investigated her for possible domestic offenses. Its inquiry did not cover espionage.
lines.shot_hint: A close detail of the Singapore finding with the agency/date visible

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore police also said she gave inaccurate information to play down her role. They issued a warning and barred her from re-entering.
lines.shot_hint: Lift a page to reveal the separate warning and the company's statement

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Megaspeed later said she had left the company in August 2025.
lines.shot_hint: Lift a page to reveal the separate warning and the company's statement

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At this point, there was a documented chip inquiry and an unanswered question about where some machines went.
lines.shot_hint: A newsroom monitor shows a dated report summary

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then, in late October, news reports raised a different question. It was about who had access to Nvidia's CEO.
lines.shot_hint: A newsroom monitor shows a dated report summary

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Reuters reported that U.S. authorities suspected Alice Huang of ties to Chinese intelligence. China denied the allegation.
lines.shot_hint: Slow move toward a closed boardroom, using sourced text outside any private interaction

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On November 8, Jensen acknowledged being unfaithful in a message to Nvidia employees. He did not name her.
lines.shot_hint: Slow move toward a closed boardroom, using sourced text outside any private interaction

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation that same day.
lines.shot_hint: A page turns to the board's public position, with a separate denial visible

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It said it had no reason at that point to believe company secrets or national security had been compromised.
lines.shot_hint: A page turns to the board's public position, with a separate denial visible

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: What information, if any, reached Beijing remains unresolved in the public record.
lines.shot_hint: A page turns to the board's public position, with a separate denial visible

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The focus had widened. The first investigation asked where the hardware went.
lines.shot_hint: A boardroom push-in settles on the file at the head of the table

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Now the board had to ask what its own company knew, and when.
lines.shot_hint: A boardroom push-in settles on the file at the head of the table

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Congress had already asked for answers.
lines.shot_hint: A House request arrives on an evidence desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In a letter dated November 4, three House committee chairs asked Jensen to brief them on his interactions with Alice Huang and Nvidia's security procedures.
lines.shot_hint: A House request arrives on an evidence desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On November 11, Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as chief executive and director. The company announced it the next day.
lines.shot_hint: Single non-speaking, illustrative Jensen portrait with a medium shot and a name tag

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Finance chief Colette Kress stepped in as interim CEO.
lines.shot_hint: Single non-speaking, illustrative Jensen portrait with a medium shot and a name tag

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then came the next scheduled event. The earnings call went ahead on November 17.
lines.shot_hint: Boardroom camera moves past a vacant chair to a conference speaker

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nvidia had just reported a record quarter, and its board chair told investors the company did not intend to bring Jensen back as CEO.
lines.shot_hint: Boardroom camera moves past a vacant chair to a conference speaker

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Sales reached a hundred fifteen point eight billion dollars. That covers the quarter that ended October 25, while Jensen was still running the company.
lines.shot_hint: An earnings screen shows 115.8 billion dollars in quarterly sales with the period end

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The number tells you what Nvidia sold over three months.
lines.shot_hint: An earnings screen shows 115.8 billion dollars in quarterly sales with the period end

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nvidia's data center division brought in most of those sales. The demand the company reported could be strong while its board still faced questions.
lines.shot_hint: Slow glide along a lit server aisle as the records questions return

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Investors had to make sense of both at once.
lines.shot_hint: Slow glide along a lit server aisle as the records questions return

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On November 19, California's attorney general announced an investigative subpoena.
lines.shot_hint: A dated subpoena summary moves onto the desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His office is asking whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China and whether Nvidia misled investors about that risk.
lines.shot_hint: A dated subpoena summary moves onto the desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: House Democrats sought records about Nvidia's communications with Commerce. Congressional committees also scheduled transcribed interviews for December.
lines.shot_hint: Interview schedule appears on a calendar in the investigation room

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: As of November 20, those interviews are still ahead. The investigations have questions that the earnings report could never answer.
lines.shot_hint: Interview schedule appears on a calendar in the investigation room

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Here's where it reaches an ordinary investor. You can own Nvidia indirectly through an index fund.
lines.shot_hint: A saver opens the fund statement at home

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Open the fund's holdings page and find the line that says Nvidia.
lines.shot_hint: A saver opens the fund statement at home

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On November 18, Nvidia made up five point seven eight percent of State Street's S and P five hundred fund, ticker S P Y.
lines.shot_hint: Push into one holdings line and show the dated 578-dollar example

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In a ten thousand dollar holding in that particular fund, that's about five hundred seventy-eight dollars of Nvidia exposure at that snapshot.
lines.shot_hint: Push into one holdings line and show the dated 578-dollar example

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That weight is a snapshot. It can change with the market and the fund's holdings.
lines.shot_hint: Close the statement and return to the saver and laptop

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: If you own a fund, its own holdings page can show you how much one company represents.
lines.shot_hint: Close the statement and return to the saver and laptop

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A big sales quarter answers one question. A subpoena raises others.
lines.shot_hint: Hold on the saver reviewing the holdings without another full-screen graphic

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The fund statement shows why both can matter to a person who never set out to invest in a single chip company.
lines.shot_hint: Hold on the saver reviewing the holdings without another full-screen graphic

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Go back to the rack in Singapore.
lines.shot_hint: Reverse the opening travel through the server aisle

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2025, there was a machine to inspect, a set of records to request, and a destination to verify.
lines.shot_hint: Reverse the opening travel through the server aisle

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A year later, those simple questions had reached Nvidia's board and public officials.
lines.shot_hint: A folder stops beside the checked Singapore-to-Malaysia leg

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The records tracked those servers as far as Malaysia.
lines.shot_hint: A folder stops beside the checked Singapore-to-Malaysia leg

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: If you were following the chips, which lead would you check first?
lines.shot_hint: Hold on the rack for the comment question and the episode-two tease

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Where the servers went next, or who could use them remotely?
lines.shot_hint: Hold on the rack for the comment question and the episode-two tease

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tell us in the comments. Next episode, we pick up the chip trail in Malaysia.
lines.shot_hint: Hold on the rack for the comment question and the episode-two tease
